scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: echo Run dev:backend, dev:frontend and dev:ai in three terminals (MongoDB must be running)
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
